scientific_integrity: The mathematical theorem is proved through a killed-chain resolvent and explicit cycle Green function. Exact-rational finite computations provide only reproducibility checks, not the infinite-parameter proof. No independent validation has been claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two death-free sites on a finite nearest-neighbor symmetric cycle, one migrating individual, uniform initial site among unprotected sites for the principal transform and variance claim, homogeneous positive killing elsewhere. No nonlinear ecology, correlated mortality, drift, or stochastic dominance assertion. Older partially absorbing random-walk literature has unresolved full-text coverage, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Uniform-start lifetime conservation and a strict refuge-separation risk order on a cyclic habitat
